text: Dating rule nobody tells you. If it's hard in the beginning, it only gets harder. Hey guys, let's talk about one advice that will save you months, even years, of wasted effort in dating. This advice is simplify, don't complicate. Here's the truth. 90% of your best dating stories will start smooth. She replies to your text, you invite her out, she says yes, you meet, you both have fun, the vibe is natural. No drama, no chasing, no convincing her. Now compare that to when it's tough from the start. She replies once every two days, cancels plans, always busy. And you keep thinking, if I just try harder, she will come around. Newsflash, she won't. Those situations almost never go anywhere. That's why you should focus on the interactions that are fun and easygoing, where her interest and energy match yours from the start. I know, movies, books, and songs will tell you the opposite. They glorify the man who fights for her heart, wins her over, proves he's worthy. But that's fiction. Real life is different. In real life, attractions should be mutual from the start, not a competition you have to win. So stop complicating. If it's heavy and hard from the beginning, let it go. Simplify your dating life. Put your energy into connections that feel natural, not forced.
